"""Seeded customer event stream with strictly prior behavioral features."""
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from collections import defaultdict, deque

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

COUNTRIES = ["USA", "GBR", "CAN", "DEU", "FRA", "NGA", "IND", "SGP", "AUS"]
TYPES = ["Purchase", "Transfer", "Withdrawal"]


def generate(n: int = 100_000, seed: int = 42) -> pd.DataFrame:
    if n < 1:
        raise ValueError("Transaction count must be positive")
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    customers = max(8, n // 45)
    popularity = rng.lognormal(0, .8, customers)
    ids = rng.choice(customers, n, p=popularity / popularity.sum())
    times = np.sort(rng.integers(0, 90 * 86400, n))
    # Groups share a customer, device and short time window. Some are benign.
    groups = np.zeros(n, dtype=int)
    labels = rng.random(n) < .003
    for i in range(0, n - 4, 4):
        if rng.random() < .026:
            ids[i:i+4] = ids[i]
            times[i:i+4] = times[i] + np.arange(4) * 19
            groups[i:i+4] = i + 1
            labels[i:i+4] = rng.random() < .72
    home = rng.choice(COUNTRIES, customers)
    prior = rng.lognormal(4.2, .75, customers)
    age = rng.integers(1, 3000, customers)
    counts = np.zeros(customers, int)
    sums = np.zeros(customers)
    recent = defaultdict(deque)
    seen = defaultdict(set)
    previous = {}
    rows = []
    epoch = datetime(2026, 7, 1)
    for i in np.argsort(times, kind="stable"):
        c, t = int(ids[i]), int(times[i])
        cluster, fraud = groups[i], bool(labels[i])
        device = f"D{c}-" + (f"B{cluster}" if cluster else str(rng.choice(4, p=[.94,.035,.02,.005])))
        amount = round(max(.01, prior[c] * rng.lognormal(-.22, .7) *
                           (rng.uniform(2, 12) if cluster or (fraud and rng.random()<.7) else 1)), 2)
        typ = "Transfer" if cluster else rng.choice(TYPES, p=[.74,.18,.08])
        dest = rng.choice(COUNTRIES) if rng.random() < (.63 if cluster else .12) else home[c]
        ip = rng.choice(COUNTRIES) if rng.random() < (.52 if cluster else .04) else home[c]
        q = recent[c]
        while q and q[0] < t - 3600:
            q.popleft()
        stamp = epoch + timedelta(seconds=t)
        category = rng.choice(["Groceries","Retail","Travel","Dining","Services"]) if typ=="Purchase" else typ
        rows.append((f"TX-{i+1:07}", f"CU-{c:05}", stamp, amount, "USD", typ, category,
                     f"M-{category[:2]}{rng.integers(1,90):03}", {"Purchase":"Card","Withdrawal":"ATM","Transfer":"Online"}[typ],
                     home[c], dest, ip, device, age[c]+t//86400,
                     (sums[c]+5*prior[c])/(counts[c]+5), previous.get(c), len(q),
                     int(device not in seen[c]), int(dest!=home[c]), int(typ=="Transfer" and rng.random()<(.75 if cluster else .12)),
                     rng.choice(["Settled","Pending","Declined"],p=[.96,.03,.01]), int(fraud)))
        q.append(t)
        previous[c] = stamp
        seen[c].add(device)
        counts[c] += 1
        sums[c] += amount
    frame = pd.DataFrame(rows, columns="transaction_id customer_id timestamp amount currency transaction_type merchant_category merchant_id channel origin destination ip_country device account_age historical_average previous_timestamp recent_count new_device international new_beneficiary status fraud_label".split())
    validate(frame)
    return frame


def validate(frame: pd.DataFrame) -> None:
    required = set("transaction_id customer_id timestamp amount historical_average recent_count account_age origin destination ip_country new_device new_beneficiary international fraud_label".split())
    if required.difference(frame) or frame[list(required)].isna().any().any():
        raise ValueError("Missing required data")
    nums = frame[["historical_average","amount","account_age","recent_count"]]
    if not np.isfinite(nums).all().all() or (nums.iloc[:,:2]<=0).any().any() or (nums.iloc[:,2:]<0).any().any():
        raise ValueError("Invalid amounts or history")
    if frame.transaction_id.duplicated().any() or pd.to_datetime(frame.timestamp, errors="coerce", format="ISO8601").isna().any():
        raise ValueError("Invalid date or duplicate transaction")
    if not frame[["fraud_label","international","new_device","new_beneficiary"]].isin([0,1]).all().all():
        raise ValueError("Indicators must be binary")

"""Shared feature contract for historical and simulated observations."""
from dataclasses import dataclass

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.ensemble import IsolationForest
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.metrics import confusion_matrix, precision_recall_fscore_support
from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler

LEVELS = ["Low Risk", "Medium Risk", "High Risk", "Critical Risk"]
RULES = ["Spending spike", "Rapid activity", "Unseen device", "IP mismatch", "New beneficiary", "Cross-border", "Young account"]
WEIGHTS = (30, 26, 14, 16, 13, 8, 6)


def features(d: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    return pd.DataFrame(dict(spend_ratio=d.amount/d.historical_average, recent=d.recent_count,
        device=d.new_device, geography=(d.origin!=d.ip_country).astype(int),
        beneficiary=d.new_beneficiary, international=d.international, age=d.account_age), index=d.index)


def contributions(d: pd.DataFrame, weights=WEIGHTS) -> pd.DataFrame:
    if len(weights)!=len(RULES) or any(w<0 or w>100 for w in weights):
        raise ValueError("Each rule needs a weight from 0 to 100")
    x = features(d)
    flags = [x.spend_ratio>=3, x.recent>=2, x.device, x.geography, x.beneficiary, x.international, x.age<30]
    return pd.DataFrame({name: flag.astype(int)*weight for name,flag,weight in zip(RULES,flags,weights)})


def classify(scores, thresholds=(25,50,75)):
    if not 0 < thresholds[0] < thresholds[1] < thresholds[2] <= 100:
        raise ValueError("Cutoffs must increase within 1–100")
    return np.array(LEVELS)[np.searchsorted(thresholds, scores, side="right")]


@dataclass
class Models:
    isolation: IsolationForest
    supervised: object
    calibration: np.ndarray
    cutoff: pd.Timestamp
    baseline_amount: float

    def predict(self, d: pd.DataFrame):
        x = features(d)
        raw = -self.isolation.score_samples(x)
        percentile = 100*np.searchsorted(self.calibration,raw,side="right")/len(self.calibration)
        return percentile, self.supervised.predict_proba(x)[:,1]


def train(d: pd.DataFrame) -> Models:
    cutoff = d.timestamp.sort_values().iloc[int(.8*len(d))]
    past = d[d.timestamp<cutoff]
    if past.fraud_label.nunique()!=2:
        raise ValueError("Training requires both label classes")
    x = features(past)
    forest = IsolationForest(n_estimators=80, random_state=42).fit(x)
    logistic = make_pipeline(StandardScaler(), LogisticRegression(max_iter=500)).fit(x,past.fraud_label)
    return Models(forest,logistic,np.sort(-forest.score_samples(x)),cutoff,float(past.amount.quantile(.99)))


def metrics(labels, predictions) -> dict:
    tn,fp,fn,tp = confusion_matrix(labels,predictions,labels=[0,1]).ravel()
    p,r,f,_ = precision_recall_fscore_support(labels,predictions,average="binary",zero_division=0)
    return dict(Precision=p,Recall=r,F1=f,FPR=fp/max(1,tn+fp),TN=tn,FP=fp,FN=fn,TP=tp)

"""Atomic dataset initialization and optimistic investigation updates."""
import logging
from pathlib import Path

import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import URL, create_engine, text

from .data import generate, validate
from .detection import classify, contributions

STATES = ["Pending Review", "Investigating", "Escalated", "Resolved"]


def database(path: Path):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    return create_engine(URL.create("sqlite", database=str(path)), connect_args={"timeout":120})


def initialize(engine, n: int = 100_000, seed: int = 42):
    with engine.begin() as con:
        con.exec_driver_sql("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        exists = con.scalar(text("SELECT count(*) FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='transactions'"))
        if exists:
            return
        logging.getLogger(__name__).info("Generating %d synthetic events", n)
        d = generate(n,seed)
        d["risk_score"] = contributions(d).sum(axis=1).clip(upper=100)
        d["risk_category"] = classify(d.risk_score)
        validate(d)
        d.to_sql("transactions",con,index=False,chunksize=1000)
        con.exec_driver_sql("CREATE UNIQUE INDEX tx_id ON transactions(transaction_id)")
        con.exec_driver_sql("CREATE INDEX customer_time ON transactions(customer_id,timestamp)")
        con.exec_driver_sql("""CREATE TABLE cases(transaction_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                             status TEXT NOT NULL, notes TEXT NOT NULL, revision INTEGER NOT NULL)""")


def case(engine, tx: str) -> dict:
    with engine.connect() as con:
        row = con.execute(text("SELECT * FROM cases WHERE transaction_id=:tx"),{"tx":tx}).mappings().first()
    return dict(row) if row else dict(transaction_id=tx,status=STATES[0],notes="",revision=0)


def save(engine, tx: str, status: str, notes: str, revision: int):
    if status not in STATES or len(notes)>4000:
        raise ValueError("Invalid investigation status or notes")
    with engine.begin() as con:
        con.exec_driver_sql("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        if not con.scalar(text("SELECT 1 FROM transactions WHERE transaction_id=:tx"), {"tx":tx}):
            raise ValueError("Unknown transaction")
        current = con.scalar(text("SELECT revision FROM cases WHERE transaction_id=:tx"), {"tx":tx}) or 0
        if current!=revision:
            raise ValueError("Another analyst updated this case. Reload before saving.")
        con.execute(text("""INSERT INTO cases VALUES (:tx,:status,:notes,:rev)
                         ON CONFLICT(transaction_id) DO UPDATE SET status=excluded.status,
                         notes=excluded.notes,revision=excluded.revision"""),
                    dict(tx=tx,status=status,notes=notes,rev=current+1))


def load(engine) -> pd.DataFrame:
    return pd.read_sql("SELECT * FROM transactions ORDER BY timestamp, transaction_id",engine,
                       parse_dates=["timestamp","previous_timestamp"])

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import plotly.express as px
import streamlit as st
from sklearn.metrics import precision_recall_curve

from .data import COUNTRIES
from .detection import classify, contributions, metrics
from .ui import TEAL, chart, evidence


def simulator(models,weights,thresholds):
    preset=st.segmented_control("Simulation scenario", ["Everyday purchase","Rapid transfer","Travel purchase"], default="Everyday purchase") or "Everyday purchase"
    rapid=preset=="Rapid transfer"
    with st.form("simulation-"+preset):
        a,b,c=st.columns(3)
        a.subheader("Transaction")
        b.subheader("Customer history")
        c.subheader("Account & access")
        amount=a.number_input("Amount (USD)",.01,1e8,850. if rapid else 75.,key=preset+"amt")
        mean=b.number_input("Historical average (USD)",.01,1e8,80.)
        age=c.number_input("Account age (days)",0,40000,365)
        home=b.selectbox("Origin country",COUNTRIES)
        dest=a.selectbox("Destination country",COUNTRIES,index=int(rapid or preset=="Travel purchase"),key=preset+"dest")
        ip=c.selectbox("IP country",COUNTRIES,index=int(preset=="Travel purchase"),key=preset+"ip")
        count=b.number_input("Prior transactions in one hour",0,10000,4 if rapid else 0,key=preset+"freq")
        device=c.checkbox("Previously unseen device",value=rapid,key=preset+"dev")
        ben=a.checkbox("New beneficiary",value=rapid,key=preset+"ben")
        submit=st.form_submit_button("Assess simulation",type="primary")
    if submit:
        st.session_state["simulation"]=(preset,dict(amount=amount,historical_average=mean,account_age=age,
            origin=home,destination=dest,ip_country=ip,recent_count=count,new_device=device,
            international=int(home!=dest),new_beneficiary=ben))
    saved=st.session_state.get("simulation")
    if saved and saved[0]==preset:
        row=pd.DataFrame([saved[1]])
        score=min(100,contributions(row,weights).sum(axis=1).item())
        anomaly,prob=models.predict(row)
        st.subheader("Simulated assessment")
        a,b,c=st.columns(3)
        a.metric(classify([score],thresholds)[0],f"{score} / 100",border=True)
        b.metric("Anomaly percentile",f"{anomaly[0]:.1f}",border=True)
        c.metric("Supervised probability",f"{prob[0]:.1%}",border=True)
        st.write(f"Transaction amount is {row.amount[0]/row.historical_average[0]:.2f}× the supplied historical average.")
        evidence(row,weights)


def performance(d,models):
    held=d[d.timestamp>=models.cutoff]
    st.caption(f"Chronological holdout from {models.cutoff} UTC · {len(held):,} filtered transactions")
    if held.empty:
        st.info("Select dates containing held-out transactions.")
        return
    a,b,c=st.columns(3)
    rt=a.slider("Rule score cutoff",0,100,25)
    at=b.slider("Anomaly percentile cutoff",0.,100.,98.)
    pt=c.slider("Supervised probability cutoff",0.,1.,.5)
    methods={"Rules":(held.risk_score,rt),"Isolation Forest":(held.anomaly,at),
             "Logistic regression":(held.probability,pt),"Amount baseline":(held.amount,models.baseline_amount)}
    results=pd.DataFrame({k:metrics(held.fraud_label,score>=t) for k,(score,t) in methods.items()}).T
    st.dataframe(results.style.format({k:"{:.1%}" for k in ["Precision","Recall","F1","FPR"]}).format(
        {k:"{:.0f}" for k in ["TN","FP","FN","TP"]}),use_container_width=True)
    name=st.selectbox("Inspect method",methods.keys())
    score,t=methods[name]
    result=results.loc[name]
    a,b=st.columns(2)
    with a:
        st.subheader("Confusion matrix")
        matrix=[[result.TN,result.FP],[result.FN,result.TP]]
        chart(px.imshow(matrix,text_auto=".0f",x=["Clear","Flagged"],y=["Label 0","Label 1"],
                        color_continuous_scale="Teal",labels=dict(x="Decision",y="Synthetic truth")))
    with b:
        st.subheader("Precision–recall curve")
        if held.fraud_label.nunique()==2:
            p,r,_=precision_recall_curve(held.fraud_label,score)
            ix=np.linspace(0,len(p)-1,min(len(p),600),dtype=int)
            chart(px.line(x=r[ix],y=p[ix],labels={"x":"Recall","y":"Precision"},color_discrete_sequence=[TEAL]))
        else:
            st.info("Both synthetic label classes are needed for this curve.")
    fp=held[(score>=t)&(held.fraud_label==0)]
    st.subheader("False-positive review")
    st.caption(f"{len(fp):,} synthetic label-0 transactions crossed the selected threshold.")
    st.dataframe(fp.nlargest(50,"amount")[["transaction_id","timestamp","amount","risk_score","anomaly","probability"]],hide_index=True)
